title: SetNumpyMatrixSafely
author: JG
description: SetNumpyMatrixSafely and SetNumpyVectorSafely: add type checks and check exceptions printed when initialized with wrong types; consider more advanced checks for standard types in itemInterface
releaseNotes: The behaviour asked about is now pinned rather than guessed: parameterConversionTest.py (revision2026 step R4.4.3.1) writes wrong types into every parameter through every access path - the SetNumpyMatrixSafely and SetNumpyVectorSafely paths included - and compares the exception type or the value that reads back against a committed reference; so a change in these checks cannot pass unnoticed. What to do about the inconsistent exception TYPES is #2432.
